description: Defines static metrics sources for Spark, including CodegenMetrics and HiveCatalogMetrics, and a container object StaticSources for accessing all sources.

classes.name: StaticSources
classes.description: Object holding references to all static metric sources.

classes.name: CodegenMetrics
classes.description: Object defining metrics related to code generation processes.

classes.name: HiveCatalogMetrics
classes.description: Object defining metrics related to Hive external catalog access.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all Hive catalog metrics counters to zero.

methods.name: incrementFileCacheHits
methods.description: Increments the file cache hits counter.

methods.name: incrementHiveClientCalls
methods.description: Increments the Hive client calls counter.

methods.name: incrementParallelListingJobCount
methods.description: Increments the parallel listing job count counter.
